scope: Only the cross-purpose observation-order residual in outputs-03. No read-operation lifecycle and no permits. The six verified fixes are unchanged.
revised_artifact_sha256_note: Not computed: only Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep are allowed.

responses.change: A single feature-level watermark `version_seq` now covers shared version-bearing facts (head, base, merge_base, binding digests) across all purposes, including pr, pass and ci when they carry version facts. Only an observation with seq > version_seq may update those facts and advance the watermark. A late observation with seq <= version_seq, of any purpose, cannot rewrite shared facts or restore an old version. Per-purpose result caches stay separate: they update only within their own purpose, cannot redefine the shared version_key, and are usable by gates only when their observed version equals the current version. An explicit cross-purpose example is added: pass seq=10/H1 arriving after pr seq=11/H2 leaves the head at H2, and that pass result cannot establish Pass.

requested_action: Independent recheck of D50-R02. No D11 approval or product gate is claimed.
